Terms & Conditions

This policy applies to the Dior Medical Urgent Care website, patient registration and login experience, appointment scheduling, online payment, patient portal, telemedicine workflows, and related services made available through the website.

The service is intended for adults 18 years and older. The project requirements state that the service does not provide care to children, patients under 18, or pregnant patients. Eligibility questions may be presented before medical intake and appointment booking.

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using the website or related services, you agree to these Terms & Conditions and any additional terms presented for specific services. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

2. Healthcare Services and Eligibility

Dior Medical provides telemedicine services subject to clinical evaluation, provider availability, applicable law, and the limitations of telemedicine. The service is intended for adults 18 years and older and is not intended for children, patients under 18, or pregnant patients.

3. No Emergency Care

The website and telemedicine service are not a substitute for emergency medical care. If you believe you have a medical emergency or a condition requiring immediate in-person attention, call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department. The final website should include the client-approved emergency disclaimer and emergency contact instructions.

4. Clinical Decisions

Submitting a questionnaire, requesting an appointment, or making a payment does not guarantee that a provider will diagnose a condition, prescribe medication, or recommend a particular treatment. Clinical decisions are made by the treating healthcare provider based on the information available and professional judgment.

5. Accounts

You are responsible for providing accurate information and protecting your login credentials. You must not share your account or use another person’s account. Dior Medical may restrict or terminate access where necessary for security, compliance, misuse, or other legitimate reasons.

6. Appointments

Appointments are subject to provider availability. The platform may support scheduling, confirmation, cancellation, and rescheduling. Specific cancellation and no-show rules must be finalized by Dior Medical and clearly disclosed before or at booking.

7. Payments

Fees, payment requirements, and applicable taxes or charges should be displayed before payment where required. Payments are expected to be processed through Stripe. A payment confirmation does not itself guarantee clinical eligibility or a prescription.

8. Prescriptions and Pharmacies

Prescriptions, when medically appropriate, are determined by the treating provider and are subject to applicable clinical, legal, and regulatory requirements. E-prescribing and pharmacy services may be provided through third parties selected by Dior Medical. A pharmacy may have its own requirements, availability, pricing, and fulfillment rules.

9. Acceptable Use

You may not misuse the website, interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorized access, submit false information, impersonate another person, upload malicious code, or use the service for unlawful purposes.

10. Third-Party Services

The service may link to or integrate with third-party platforms, including payment, telemedicine, e-prescribing, pharmacy, hosting, communications, and healthcare workflow providers. Their own terms and policies may apply.

11. Intellectual Property

Website content, branding, software, design, text, graphics, and other materials are owned by or licensed to Dior Medical or its applicable licensors and may not be copied, modified, distributed, or commercially exploited without authorization.

12. Disclaimer and Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the website and non-clinical technology services are provided subject to their available functionality and without guarantees that the website will always be uninterrupted, error-free, or available. Nothing in these Terms is intended to exclude or limit liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

13. Changes

Dior Medical may update these Terms when its services, technology, vendors, or legal requirements change. The updated version will be posted on the website with an updated effective date where appropriate.

14. Governing Law and Contact

The final governing-law, dispute-resolution, jurisdiction, and contact provisions must be completed by Dior Medical’s legal counsel based on the applicable legal entity and service jurisdictions.
